hints.title: Hop Multiplication Structure
hints.text: Hopping to an intermediate smaller value before a larger value yields strictly less score than jumping directly to the larger peak.

hints.title: Decreasing Suffix Dominance
hints.text: Optimal stopping points correspond to elements that dominate all future elements in the array.

hints.title: Monotonic Filtering
hints.text: Maintain candidate indices in a monotonic sequence where smaller preceding values get evicted by larger incoming values. Sum the hopping score along the remaining indices.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each index is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible hopping combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear auxiliary memory tracks suffix peaks efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that hopping to suffix maximums is strictly optimal.
